available.label: Available
available.consequence: The described public experience is ready to inspect.
available.evidence: Repository-validated public content and deterministic interface tests.

demonstrative-preview.label: Demonstrative preview
demonstrative-preview.consequence: You can review the complete interaction, but no native or remote state changes.
demonstrative-preview.evidence: Deterministic Phase 3 adapters and no-change receipts.

under-validation.label: Under validation
under-validation.consequence: Do not assume compatibility or a performance result until evidence is complete.
under-validation.evidence: The validation boundary and missing proof are stated with each claim.

planned.label: Planned
planned.consequence: The capability is part of the roadmap and is not available for use.
planned.evidence: The owning roadmap phase is named; no delivery date is promised.

unsupported.label: Unsupported
unsupported.consequence: The configuration is outside the supported product boundary.
unsupported.evidence: The compatibility boundary explains why no action is offered.

unavailable.label: Unavailable
unavailable.consequence: The action is blocked and no bypass is provided.
unavailable.evidence: The missing authority or trust artifact is identified.

records.title: Performance control you can inspect
records.summary: Preparation, evidence, and restoration are one reviewable sequence.
records.body: Liiiraa Boost is building a Windows 10 and 11 desktop optimizer that keeps every recommendation explainable and reversible. This phase proves the interface and contracts; it does not claim measured hardware gains or native authority.
limitations: Real hardware observation and privileged Windows changes arrive in later phases.
No gain, issue count, launch date, or universal compatibility is claimed.

evidence.scope: Deterministic desktop review, evidence, and recovery journeys
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Native optimization behavior and per-machine performance remain unproven.

sections.title: Prepare
sections.body: Review dependencies, risk, and consequences before any future operation.

sections.title: Prove
sections.body: Inspect source, scope, version, validation state, and what remains unproven.

sections.title: Restore
sections.body: Keep history and recovery visible as part of the plan, not as an afterthought.

records.title: Evidence before conclusions
records.summary: Claims stay attached to their origin, scope, version, and validation boundary.
records.body: The current evidence proves authored product behavior and deterministic preview states. It does not prove a gain on an unobserved PC. Measured, observed, derived, user-provided, simulated, and unavailable values remain visibly distinct.
limitations: Deterministic preview evidence cannot substitute for representative Windows hardware measurement.
A validated schema does not make a simulated value authoritative.

evidence.scope: Repository content admission and deterministic scenario evidence
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Representative device and game measurements are not yet available.

sections.title: What is proven
sections.body: Route ownership, content admission, preview boundaries, and recovery interaction are executable.

sections.title: What is not proven
sections.body: No public record currently supports a numerical performance result for a real machine.

records.title: One compatibility flow, explicit limits
records.summary: Windows 10 and Windows 11 share one review flow until verified evidence requires a difference.
records.body: Select the Windows generation and architecture you actually use. The result describes the current support boundary only; CPU, GPU, storage, game profile, drivers, and lifecycle evidence still determine whether a future optimization can be recommended.
limitations: Windows 10 lifecycle and edition support must be checked against current Microsoft support.
ARM64, unsupported Windows builds, and unknown hardware receive no compatibility claim.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Specific hardware and game support require observed inventory and validated profiles.

supportMatrix.consequence: The same questions and evidence rules apply to both Windows generations.
No recommendation is shown before real inventory and profile evidence exist.
The interface can be reviewed, but Windows state cannot be changed in Phase 3.
No optimization or compatibility conclusion is offered.

records.title: Plans without hidden terms
records.summary: Capabilities and commercial consequences are visible before any simulated confirmation.
records.body: Checkout authority does not exist in Phase 3. The records below are capability previews, not offers to purchase. The page uses no artificial commercial pressure, fabricated endorsement, or safety paywall.
limitations: No paid plan, transaction, entitlement, renewal, or refund can be created in this phase.
Final prices and commercial terms require Phase 4 authority and a new reviewed publication.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Final commercial prices and payment-provider behavior are not yet approved.

plans.name: Deterministic product preview
plans.taxes: No taxes are charged because no transaction is available
plans.refunds: No payment is accepted, so no refund event can exist
plans.deviceRules: No device entitlement or binding is created
plans.expirationEffects: Preview access does not create or expire a paid entitlement
plans.checkoutBoundary: Phase 4 authority required; confirmation remains simulated and changes no remote state

capabilities.name: Public product, evidence, and compatibility review

records.title: Search public, validated content
records.summary: Results expose content type, locale, version, availability, and validation state.
records.body: Search is submitted explicitly and stored in the URL. It indexes only admitted public records and never account, admin, scenario, preview-authority, or internal records.
limitations: Current search covers repository-authored records shipped with this public application.
Private data and obsolete actionable content are never included.

evidence.scope: Public-only route, locale, version, availability, and validation filters
evidence.unprovenBoundary: No external or private content source is connected.

searchCopy.label: Search product, evidence, compatibility, plans, and support
searchCopy.emptyBody: Revise the query or remove a filter. Search does not expose private content or incompatible versions without notice.

records.title: Support begins with a safe path
records.summary: Start with public documentation and share only the minimum data needed.
records.body: Public support explains recovery and escalation without collecting diagnostics in this phase. Future submissions must preview every field, allow removal, and require explicit consent.
limitations: No support case, attachment, diagnostic bundle, or account record is submitted in Phase 3.
Do not include passwords, authentication secrets, payment data, or unrelated personal information.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Authenticated case authority and consent-scoped diagnostics arrive in Phase 4.

collectionPoint.requiredFields: No data is collected by this public page
collectionPoint.retention: No submission means no support record is retained
collectionPoint.revocation: Future consent can be withdrawn before submission and through the privacy center
